title: usenet-ipfs-reader: wire live data sources
description: The reader's RFC 3977 protocol harness is complete but commands return empty/stub data. This epic wires the real rust-ipfs block store, group_log queries, overview index population, and a credential file into the running reader. Outcome: a newsreader client (slrn, Thunderbird) can GROUP, ARTICLE, OVER against real data posted through the reader's POST command. Why: until data sources are wired, the reader passes protocol tests but cannot serve real content.
